lexicon.name: Lexicon
lexicon.description: A local, model-centered application for understanding a codebase through its domain meaning, software architecture, and inspected source. This initial self-index covers the active Viewer and the product guidance that governs it.

context.name: Shared Understanding
context.description: The durable account a team develops while making a codebase easier to understand.
context.code-link: Explains that one shared model develops through questions and incremental refinement.

concept.name: Project
concept.description: An indexed codebase with a selected source root and an artifact root where its shared [[lexicon-model|Lexicon Model]] can live.
concept.code-link: Resolves built-in and registered projects before the Viewer serves their model, source, canvas, or conversation.

concept.name: Lexicon Model
concept.description: The versioned, shared semantic document that names a project’s domain ideas, architecture, relationships, flows, annotations, and [[source-evidence|source evidence]].
concept.annotation: Only schema 3.3 parses and serializes as a current model; unavailable or mismatched documents remain separate from an empty model.
concept.code-link: Defines the current model document and the meaning of its supported item types.
Defines the shared schema version and model contract consumed by the viewer and server.
Parses the XML document into the shared model representation.

concept.name: Source Evidence
concept.description: A declared mapping from a model item to an implementation or documentary target, retaining its kind, locator, role, and explanation without making that target a new semantic item.
concept.code-link: Separates code and document source kinds, locators, roles, and evidence qualification.
Defines the explicit code and document source-link variants used by the shared contract.

context.name: Guided Exploration
context.description: The work of asking questions, following model connections, inspecting evidence, and explicitly refining the shared account of a project.
context.code-link: Describes browsing concepts and relationships before opening the implementation behind an explanation.

concept.name: Model Refinement
concept.description: An explicit, validated change to a [[lexicon-model|Lexicon Model]] made after a team member’s question or request; exploratory discussion does not itself change the document.
concept.annotation: The server checks the starting snapshot and changed source links before saving, and undo refuses to overwrite an externally changed model.
concept.code-link: Validates and saves an explicit model edit only when its expected document fingerprint still matches.

person.name: Team Member
person.description: A person who asks questions about a [[project|Project]], uses the Viewer to inspect its model and evidence, and decides which refinements belong in the shared account.

system.name: Lexicon Viewer
system.description: The local application that lets a team explore and refine a project’s [[lexicon-model|shared model]] alongside its source evidence.
system.code-link: States the Viewer’s purpose of connecting domain meaning, architecture, and code in one shared model.

container.name: Viewer Client
container.description: The browser application that coordinates the reader, canvas, source reader, and agent conversation around the current project model.
container.code-link: Mounts the project reader and composes its model, canvas, source, and conversation surfaces.

component.name: Reader Workspace
component.description: The navigable reading surface that loads a project model, opens model cards, and coordinates the adjacent canvas and source reader.
component.code-link: Fetches the current project model and coordinates reader, canvas, source, and chat state.

component.name: Canvas Workspace
component.description: The tldraw-based presentation of model elements, relationships, and derived source targets; its views and drawings do not change semantic membership.
component.code-link: Selects the flat, Planes, or optional Files presentation from the shared model and workspace state.

component.name: Source Reader
component.description: The evidence-reading surface that opens a declared code or document target and lets a reader return to the owning model item.
component.code-link: Renders the source-reading pane for the selected declared target.

component.name: Agent Conversation
component.description: The client conversation surface that carries selected model context to a local coding runtime and refreshes the reader after an applied model change.
component.code-link: Connects the conversation UI to project chat events, provider status, and model-change refreshes.

container.name: Local Viewer Server
container.description: The loopback server that registers projects, serves models and declared source, persists viewer artifacts, and coordinates local agent conversations.
container.code-link: Defines the local API that serves project models, source links, canvas state, settings, and conversation actions.

component.name: Model Service
component.description: The model boundary that reads, parses, validates, serializes, and loads the current XML document without silently interpreting older schemas.
component.code-link: Separates a current parsed model from a schema-mismatch or invalid-document problem.
Checks structural model invariants before serialization or after parsing.

component.name: Conversation Service
component.description: The server-side conversation coordinator that starts local agent turns, records their state, applies explicit edits, and supports stop, reset, canvas commands, and undo.
component.code-link: Coordinates project conversation state and delegates explicit model edits through the server-owned flow.

component.name: Source Service
component.description: The constrained source resolver that reads only declared targets inside the selected code root and reports their code or document status.
component.code-link: Resolves a declared source link into a bounded code or documentary excerpt.

relationship.name: explores
relationship.description: A Team Member selects a Project to ask questions, follow its model, and inspect declared evidence through the local Viewer.

relationship.name: keeps
relationship.description: A Project’s selected artifact root holds its one shared Lexicon Model when it has been authored.
relationship.code-link: Finds the artifact root that owns a project’s model document, including the primary worktree fallback.

relationship.name: declares
relationship.description: The Lexicon Model owns source links so a reader can trace an explanation to code or documentary evidence without treating files as semantic members.

relationship.name: supports
relationship.description: The Viewer realizes Guided Exploration by keeping reading, visual navigation, source inspection, and conversation around the same shared model.

relationship.name: loads
relationship.description: The Reader Workspace requests the selected project model from the Local Viewer Server before it renders reading and canvas surfaces.
relationship.code-link: Fetches the project model from the local API and stores it as the current reader data.
Serves the current model document and revision for a project.

relationship.name: coordinates
relationship.description: The Reader Workspace supplies the current model, selection, commands, and local workspace state to the Canvas Workspace.

relationship.name: presents
relationship.description: The Canvas Workspace projects model elements and declared source targets into Diagram, Atlas, Combined, Planes, or optional Files presentations without redefining their semantics.
relationship.code-link: Indexes model items and authored source links for graph and source-target projection.

relationship.name: opens
relationship.description: When a reader chooses a declared source mapping or target, the Reader Workspace opens it in the Source Reader while preserving reading navigation.

relationship.name: resolves
relationship.description: The Source Reader asks the Local Viewer Server for a declared target; the Source Service confines the result to the selected source root and reports missing or ambiguous locators explicitly.
relationship.code-link: Requests the selected target from the project code endpoint before rendering it.
Finds a declared source link and delegates it to the constrained source resolver.

relationship.name: requests
relationship.description: A Team Member must make the change request explicit; exploratory questions remain discussion rather than an automatic document mutation.

relationship.name: requests an explicit change through
relationship.description: A Team Member types an explicit refinement request into Agent Conversation. That surface is the software participant for the request; [[model-refinement]] remains the domain name of an authorized document change.
relationship.code-link: The conversation pane is the surface a Team Member uses to send an explicit request with selected context.

relationship.name: submits
relationship.description: The Agent Conversation sends the selected context, model revision, and a user message to the Local Viewer Server, then receives streamed conversation state.
relationship.code-link: Maintains the project chat event stream and submits user conversation actions through the local API.
Routes send, stop, undo, reset, and answer actions to the conversation coordinator.

relationship.name: applies
relationship.description: After a local coding agent returns an explicit edit, the Conversation Service validates the model snapshot and changed evidence before it saves the Model Refinement or reports why it was rejected.
relationship.code-link: Owns the turn lifecycle that applies explicit model edits and records their result in conversation state.

relationship.name: validates an edit through
relationship.description: After extracting an explicit patch or migration, Conversation Service applies it in memory and asks Model Service to parse and serialize the candidate. Structural failure leaves the on-disk document unchanged.
relationship.code-link: Applies an explicit patch or migration during the turn, then serializes the candidate before commit.
Serializes only a structurally valid schema 3.3 document.

relationship.name: changes
relationship.description: A successful Model Refinement replaces the current document only after structural and changed-link validation against the turn’s starting snapshot.

relationship.name: replaces the shared document within
relationship.description: Within Conversation Service, a validated candidate is written only when the artifact still matches the turn’s starting snapshot and changed source links resolve. [[model-refinement]] names that authorized change; [[lexicon-model]] names the document that is replaced.
relationship.code-link: Commits a validated candidate after changed-link checks and records exact previous bytes for undo.
Replaces model.xml only when the artifact still matches the expected snapshot.

flow.name: Inspect Declared Evidence
flow.description: A Team Member opens an indexed Project, whose current model has already been loaded into the Reader Workspace, then follows one declared source mapping. The outcome is a bounded source excerpt alongside the model explanation, not a new source link.
flow.step: Open the selected declared source target
Resolve and render the declared evidence

flow.name: Explicit Model Refinement
flow.description: A Team Member asks for a concrete change after discussion. The Agent Conversation submits the turn; the Conversation Service validates and applies it. The outcome is either a saved, undoable new Lexicon Model or a visible rejection that preserves the existing document.
flow.step: Send the selected context and request
Validate and apply the agent’s explicit edit
Replace the shared model only when validation succeeds
